title: DB: Rhys's Friday-to-cutover plan with a stop rule each day
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/RHYS-CUTOVER-WEEK-PLAN.md: Friday6 backup dump plus full restore-and-compare; Saturday7 scheduled wipe conditional on exact rehearsal/review/separate authority; Monday9 meeting; Tuesday10 and Wednesday11 actual primary/cover admin-code checks; Thursday12 final cutover and opening decision. Each day has Rhys's actions, owners/evidence and STOP rule.

Preserves Friday build/test deadline, frozen version/affected retests, source versus target writer boundaries, fresh Thursday recovery checkpoint/final exports (Friday's dump is not current), exact138/140/141/144/145/146 verified order, no blind repeat of Saturday clearing, signed scope and no146 reinstall after rollback. Keeps builder4's existing sign-off masters and links the new supporting sheets. This plan grants no operation/SQL authority.

Checks: all six dates/weekdays and evidence paths reviewed; six explicit stop-rule rows. No actual backup/wipe/MFA/cutover/test execution or signature claimed. No main merge, production SQL, Ready label or new feature. Exact head 8ca0aac7067bade11de78272f46d4a19aa0dab5f.
